description: Integral float 2.0 requested as integer — Node limitation documented

limitations.node: Node OpenFeature exposes a single number resolver; int vs float discrimination is not available at the provider boundary.
limitations.python: v1's FlagType has exactly four members (boolean/string/number/object), no integer/float split (conformance/surface/control-points.surface.json: 'number, NOT integer') — the same simplification node's own limitation describes, applied uniformly by the v1 cut.
